text: There is insufficient evidence to determine the tree-cover change status of this rural property (ASSET-K) between 2021 and 2025. The assessment lacks data due to missing coverage—none of the required datasets (Hansen GFC, JRC GFC2020, or MGAP 2021) were available for analysis. Consequently, no observations were made, and the claim of tree-cover loss or compliance cannot be confirmed or refuted. The assessment does not establish whether loss occurred, whether the asset is compliant, or even that no loss took place. Further data collection or alternative sources are needed to evaluate this asset's tree-cover status.
